title_en: Bathroom Renovation Burnaby BC 2026: Metrotown, Brentwood & Edmonds Cost Guide
title_zh: 本拿比浴室翻新 2026：Metrotown、Brentwood 和 Edmonds 费用指南
excerpt_en: Real costs, neighbourhood guides, and permit info for bathroom renovations in Burnaby's Metrotown, Brentwood and Edmonds areas — based on a $26K–$30K two-bathroom Metrotown project.
excerpt_zh: 基于本拿比 Metrotown 一个 $26K–$30K 双浴室翻新项目，介绍 Metrotown、Brentwood 和 Edmonds 浴室翻新的真实费用、社区信息和许可证要求。
content_en:
When a Metrotown homeowner contacted us in early 2025, the master bathroom had original 1990s pink tile, a vanity with water damage, and a freestanding tub that no longer drained properly. The second bathroom showed similar age — cracked grout, an exhaust fan that rattled, and dated fixtures throughout. Together, the two-bathroom renovation came in at $26,000 – $30,000 and was completed in 4–5 weeks.

This guide walks through what that project involved, what Burnaby homeowners actually pay in 2026, and how the city's permit process works for bathroom renovations.

Why Burnaby Homeowners Renovate Their Bathrooms

Burnaby's housing stock splits roughly into three categories that drive different renovation needs:

  • 1980s–1990s condos in Metrotown and Brentwood — original fixtures, dated tile, plumbing that's starting to show its age. These units typically need full bathroom rip-outs rather than refreshes.
  • Townhouses in Edmonds and Highgate — often have one main bathroom plus a powder room. Homeowners frequently expand the main bath or convert a powder room into a full bath.
  • Single-family homes in Burnaby Heights and Montego Winthom� — larger projects with structural possibilities. Some homeowners add ensuites or expand existing bathrooms.

The Metrotown Two-Bathroom Renovation: What It Looked Like

Our Metrotown project involved a complete rip-out of both bathrooms in a 1,400 sq ft condo. Here's the breakdown:

  • Demolition and disposal: $2,800 – $3,200
  • Plumbing rough-in and reconfiguration: $4,500 – $5,500
  • Electrical updates (new GFCI circuits, LED lighting): $1,800 – $2,400
  • Tiling (floor and shower — porcelain tile, heated floor): $5,200 – $6,800
  • Custom vanity and quartz countertop: $3,800 – $4,600
  • Bathtub and shower fixtures: $2,400 – $3,200
  • Toilets (two): $900 – $1,200
  • Paint, trim, and accessories: $1,200 – $1,600
  • Labour and project management: $4,400 – $5,200

The homeowners chose a curbless shower in the master bath with dual handheld heads, a quartz-surround soaker tub, and porcelain hex floor tile with radiant heated floors underneath. The second bathroom kept the same layout but used a pre-fab shower unit to keep costs down.

Burnaby Permit Requirements for Bathroom Renovations

Not every bathroom renovation needs a permit in Burnaby. The rules:

  • No permit needed: Cosmetic updates — replacing fixtures, painting, tiling over existing tile, replacing a vanity.
  • Permit required: Any plumbing reconfiguration, moving drains or water supply lines, changing the layout, adding a window, or adding a new bathroom (converting a powder room to a full bath).
  • Permit required: Any electrical work beyond simple fixture replacement — adding new circuits, installing heated floors, adding a bidet seat.

Burnaby's building department processes bathroom permits within 5–10 business days for straightforward renovations. Projects involving structural changes or multi-unit buildings may take longer. Our team handles the permit application as part of the project — homeowners don't need to submit anything themselves.

Metrotown: What to Expect

Metrotown is Burnaby's urban centre, with high-rise condos dominating the skyline. Condo bathroom renovations here come with specific considerations:

  • Strata approval: Most condos require strata approval before any plumbing or electrical work. This typically adds 2–4 weeks to the timeline. We coordinate directly with strata management on behalf of homeowners.
  • Elevator bookings: Material deliveries and demo debris removal need to be scheduled around building elevator availability. Most strata buildings require advance booking.
  • Sound considerations: Renovation work in occupied condo units is typically restricted to weekday business hours (9 AM – 5 PM) per most strata bylaws.

Brentwood: Growing Demand, Growing Renovation Projects

Brentwood has seen rapid densification since 2018, with thousands of new condo units completed. Many first-time renovators are tackling their first bathroom project. Common requests:

  • Converting a bathtub alcove to a walk-in shower (easier access, modern look)
  • Replacing laminate countertops with quartz in original-builder-grade bathrooms
  • Adding a second vanity to master baths that only have one sink

Edmonds: Townhouses and the Value of a Second Bathroom

Burnaby's Edmonds neighbourhood is dominated by townhouses from the 1990s and early 2000s. The typical Edmonds bathroom renovation we see is a powder room conversion — adding a shower and expanding a half-bath into a full bath. This is one of the highest-ROI renovations in the area, as it converts unusable square footage into livable space and adds a second full bathroom to a home that may only have one.

How Long Does a Bathroom Renovation Take in Burnaby?

For a complete two-bathroom renovation in Burnaby:

  • Planning and permitting: 3–6 weeks (longer if strata approval is needed)
  • Demolition: 2–4 days
  • Plumbing and electrical rough-in: 5–8 days
  • Tiling and waterproofing: 4–7 days
  • Fixture installation: 3–5 days
  • Final inspection and punch list: 2–3 days

Total: 4–6 weeks for a full renovation, not including planning. A simple refresh (new vanity, tile overlay, fixture swap) can be done in 1–2 weeks.

What Adds the Most Value in a Burnaby Bathroom Renovation?

Based on recent resale data for Burnaby properties:

  • Quartz countertops: Consistently expected by buyers. Replacing laminate with quartz in a bathroom has an estimated ROI of 70–80% at resale.
  • Curbless / walk-in showers: Accessibility is increasingly valued, and a curbless entry reads as modern and premium.
  • Double vanity in master bath: Standard expectation in homes listed above $900K. Single-vanity master baths are frequently flagged by buyers' agents.
  • Heated floors: A premium feature that buyers notice in winter showings. Costs $800–$1,500 depending on bathroom size.

content_zh:
2025 年初，一位 Metrotown 的业主联系我们时，主浴室仍保留着 1990 年代的粉色瓷砖，洗漱台有水渍损坏，独立式浴缸排水不畅。第二间浴室状况类似——瓷砖裂缝、排风扇噪音大、配件老旧。两间浴室的全面翻新工程造价 $26,000 – $30,000，工期 4–5 周。

本指南详细介绍该项目的实际情况、2026 年本拿比业主的实际花费，以及该市的浴室翻新许可流程。

本拿比业主为什么要翻新浴室

本拿比的房屋大致分为三类，每类有不同的翻新需求：

  • Metrotown 和 Brentwood 地区 1980–1990 年代公寓——原装配件、瓷砖老旧、管道开始出现问题。这类单元通常需要全面拆旧翻新，而非简单更新。
  • Edmonds 和 Highgate 地区的联排别墅——通常一间主浴室加一间洗手间。业主经常扩建主卧浴室或将洗手间升级为全功能浴室。
  • Burnaby Heights 和 Montego Winthom 地区的独栋住宅——可进行更大规模的工程，部分业主选择增加套房或扩建现有浴室。

Metrotown 双浴室翻新工程实录

我们的 Metrotown 项目是对一套 1,400 平方英尺公寓的两间浴室进行全面拆旧翻新。费用明细如下：

  • 拆除和清运：$2,800 – $3,200
  • 管道改造和布局调整：$4,500 – $5,500
  • 电路升级（新 GFCI 回路、LED 照明）：$1,800 – $2,400
  • 瓷砖铺设（地板和淋浴区——釉面瓷砖、地暖）：$5,200 – $6,800
  • 定制浴室柜和石英石台面：$3,800 – $4,600
  • 浴缸和淋浴配件：$2,400 – $3,200
  • 马桶（两间）：$900 – $1,200
  • 油漆、收边和配件：$1,200 – $1,600
  • 人工和项目管理：$4,400 – $5,200

业主在主卧浴室选择了无障碍步入式淋浴间（双手持花洒）、石英石环绕浸泡浴缸，以及带地暖的六角瓷砖地板。次浴室保留原有布局但使用了预制淋浴间以控制成本。

本拿比浴室翻新的许可要求

并非所有浴室翻新都需要许可证。本拿比的规定如下：

  • 无需许可证： Cosmetic 更新——更换配件、刷漆、在现有瓷砖上铺贴瓷砖、更换浴室柜。
  • 需要许可证： 任何管道重新配置、移动排水管或供水管线、改变布局、增设窗户或增设新浴室（将洗手间升级为全功能浴室）。
  • 需要许可证： 任何简单配件更换以外的电气工程——新增回路、安装地暖、安装智能马桶盖。

本拿比建筑部门对简单浴室翻新通常在 5–10 个工作日 内完成审批。涉及结构变更或多单元建筑的工程审批时间更长。我们团队负责代为提交许可申请——业主无需自行办理。

Metrotown：需要了解的情况

Metrotown 是本拿比的城市中心，高层公寓林立。公寓浴室翻新有以下特殊注意事项：

  • 物业审批： 大多数公寓在进行任何管道或电气工程前需要物业审批。这通常使整个时间线延长 2–4 周。我们代表业主直接与物业管理处协调。
  • 电梯预订： 材料配送和拆除垃圾清运需要按大楼电梯可用时间安排。大多数物业楼要求提前预订。
  • 噪音规定： 正在居住的公寓单元的装修施工时间通常限于工作日上班时间（上午 9 点至下午 5 点），多数物业附例均有此规定。

Brentwood：快速成长，装修需求增加

自 2018 年以来，Brentwood 经历了快速密集化发展，数千套新公寓完工。许多首次装修者正在进行第一次浴室翻新项目。常见需求：

  • 将浴缸位改为步入式淋浴间（更方便使用，外观更现代）
  • 将原始建筑级层压板台面更换为石英石
  • 在只有单个洗手台的主卧浴室增设双洗手台

Edmonds：联排别墅和第二间浴室的价值

Edmonds 社区以 1990 年代至 2000 年代初的联排别墅为主。我们在该地区最常见的浴室翻新项目是将洗手间升级为全功能浴室——将半浴室扩建为带淋浴的完整浴室。这是该地区投资回报率最高的装修项目之一，因为将无法使用的面积转化为可用空间，并为可能只有一间浴室的房屋增加了第二间完整浴室。

本拿比浴室翻新需要多长时间？

本拿比全面两间浴室翻新工程时间安排：

  • 规划和许可： 3–6 周（如果需要物业审批则更长）
  • 拆除： 2–4 天
  • 管道和电气基础工程： 5–8 天
  • 瓷砖铺设和防水： 4–7 天
  • 配件安装： 3–5 天
  • 最终验收和整改清单： 2–3 天

总计：全面翻新 4–6 周（不含规划阶段）。简单更新（更换浴室柜、瓷砖贴面、配件更换）可在 1–2 周内完成。

本拿比浴室翻新哪些项目增值最多？

根据本拿比房产最新转售数据：

  • 石英石台面： 买家普遍期待。浴室中将层压板台面更换为石英石，转售投资回报率约为 70–80%。
  • 无障碍/步入式淋浴间： 无障碍设计越来越受重视，无障碍入口被视为现代和高品质的标志。
  • 主卧双洗手台： 在挂牌价超过 $90 万的房屋中已是标准配置。买家经纪经常指出只有单洗手台的主卧浴室的不足。
  • 地暖： 买家在冬季看房时会注意到的加分项。费用视浴室面积而定，约为 $800–$1,500。

获取本拿比浴室翻新报价

Reno Stars 自 2018 年以来在本拿比已完成超过 40 项浴室翻新工程，覆盖 Metrotown、Brentwood、Edmonds 和 Burnaby Heights 地区。我们提供固定价格报价——而非会在工程中途增长的估算价格。

请致电 +1-604-555-0194 或使用本页表格预约现场评估。我们将测量空间、了解您的需求，并在 3 个工作日内为您提供书面报价。

faqs_en.question: Do I need a permit for a bathroom renovation in Burnaby?
faqs_en.answer: It depends on the scope. Cosmetic changes like replacing fixtures, repainting, or tiling over existing tile do not need a permit. Any plumbing reconfiguration, layout changes, electrical work beyond fixture replacement, or adding a new bathroom requires a permit. Reno Stars handles the permit application for you.

faqs_en.question: How much does a bathroom renovation cost in Burnaby in 2026?
faqs_en.answer: A complete bathroom renovation in Burnaby typically ranges from $15,000 to $45,000 depending on size and scope. A mid-range full rip-out with new tile, quartz countertop, walk-in shower, and updated plumbing averages $20,000–$30,000. The Metrotown two-bathroom project we completed came in at $26,000–$30,000.

faqs_en.question: How long does a full bathroom renovation take in Burnaby?
faqs_en.answer: A full bathroom renovation takes 4–6 weeks of construction time, not including planning and permitting. Condo projects requiring strata approval add 2–4 weeks. Simple refreshes (new vanity, fixture swap, tile overlay) take 1–2 weeks.

faqs_en.question: What is the ROI of a bathroom renovation in Burnaby?
faqs_en.answer: A well-executed bathroom renovation in Burnaby typically recoups 65–80% of its cost at resale. Upgraded bathrooms are listed as a top-3 feature by buyers' agents in the area, alongside updated kitchens and energy-efficient windows.

faqs_en.question: Can I renovate a bathroom in a strata building in Burnaby?
faqs_en.answer: Yes, but you need strata council approval before starting. This typically takes 2–4 weeks. Reno Stars has experience coordinating with Burnaby stratas and handles all documentation and communication on behalf of the homeowner.

faqs_zh.question: 在本拿比翻新浴室需要许可证吗？
faqs_zh.answer: 取决于工程范围。更换配件、刷漆、在现有瓷砖上铺贴瓷砖等美观类更新无需许可证。任何管道重新配置、布局变更、简单配件更换以外的电气工程，或增设新浴室都需要许可证。Reno Stars 团队将代您办理许可证申请。

faqs_zh.question: 2026 年本拿比浴室翻新费用是多少？
faqs_zh.answer: 本拿比全面浴室翻新费用通常在 $15,000 至 $45,000 之间，具体取决于面积和工程范围。中档全面拆旧翻新（新瓷砖、石英石台面、步入式淋浴间、管道升级）平均为 $20,000–$30,000。我们完成的 Metrotown 双浴室项目造价为 $26,000–$30,000。

faqs_zh.question: 本拿比全面浴室翻新需要多长时间？
faqs_zh.answer: 全面浴室翻新施工时间为 4–6 周（不含规划和许可阶段）。需要物业审批的公寓项目另加 2–4 周。简单更新（更换浴室柜、配件、瓷砖贴面）需 1–2 周。

faqs_zh.question: 本拿比浴室翻新的投资回报率是多少？
faqs_zh.answer: 本拿比精心施工的浴室翻新转售时通常可收回成本的 65–80%。升级后的浴室是当地买家经纪列出的前三大卖点之一，另外两个是翻新厨房和节能窗户。

faqs_zh.question: 我可以在本拿比的物业楼里翻新浴室吗？
faqs_zh.answer: 可以，但开工前需要获得物业委员会批准。这通常需要 2–4 周。Reno Stars 有与本拿比各物业协调的经验，代表业主处理所有文件工作和沟通联络。
